二.story: Two lines, the lower one longer: two.

四.story: A room with two legs standing inside: four walls, four.

五.story: Two lines with a frame between them: five.

六.story: A lid on top of a split: six.

七.story: A cross whose foot kicks to the right: seven.

八.story: Two strokes spreading apart: eight, and dividing.

九.story: An arm crooked at the elbow: nine.

百.story: One on top of white: a hundred.

千.story: Ten with a stroke on top: a thousand.

万.story: A lid over a hooked stroke: ten thousand.

円.story: A round coin stamped into a box: yen, circle.

金.story: Nuggets buried under the king's roof: gold, money.

銀.story: The stubborn metal that stays bright: silver.

買.story: Catching shells in a net: buying, since shells were money.

売.story: A samurai with a covered basket on legs, selling door to door.

借.story: A person who borrowed it long ago and still hasn't given it back.

貸.story: Money given in place of something: to lend.

代.story: A person takes over the post at the stake: a substitute, a generation, the fee you pay in exchange.

品.story: Three boxes stacked on the shop floor: goods.

物.story: A cow, the most common thing to own: a thing.

服.story: Clothing held against the body: clothes.

日.story: A circle with a dot at the centre, squared off by the brush. Sun by picture, day by consequence.

月.story: A crescent moon. In body kanji the same shape means flesh.

曜.story: Birds flap across the sun, one for each day: a weekday.

年.story: A farmer carrying the harvest: a year.

時.story: The temple bell and the sun together divide the day into hours.

今.story: Under the umbrella, one drop hooks down right now: now.
traps: order (N3): a dot where 今 has a line

午.story: A pestle standing straight up, like the sun at midday: noon.
traps: cow: the vertical pokes through the top

半.story: A cow split down the middle: half.

分.story: A sword dividing something into parts: part, minute, and to understand (to take it apart).

毎.story: Mother wearing her hat, as she does every day: every.

週.story: One full lap of the road. Seven days and you are back where you started.

間.story: Sunlight showing through the gap in the gate: an interval, between.

去.story: Leaving your own plot of earth behind: to leave, the past.

早.story: The sun just clearing the cross on the horizon: early.

昼.story: The sun measured at its highest line: daytime.

朝.story: The sun rising through the grass while the moon is still up: morning.

夕.story: A crescent moon just rising: evening.

夜.story: A person under a roof as the moon rises: night.

始.story: A woman steps up onto the platform to begin.

終.story: The thread runs out in winter. Nothing comes after.

計.story: Counting out loud up to ten: to measure.

人.story: A pair of legs mid-stride, seen from the side. Everything human in kanji hangs off this shape.
traps: enter: same two strokes, opposite crossing
eight: the legs split apart and never meet

父.story: Two crossed axes, the tools of a father: father.

母.story: A woman with two dots: mother.

子.story: A baby wrapped up with its arms out: child.

女.story: A woman kneeling with her arms crossed: woman.

男.story: Strength applied to a field. This is the historical picture, not a modern claim.

名.story: In the dark you call out your name so people know who you are.

会.story: Clouds roll in and everyone gathers under one umbrella: a meeting.

兄.story: A big mouth on legs, bossing you around: older brother.

弟.story: A small bow tied with cord for the youngest: younger brother.

姉.story: The woman who takes you to the market: older sister.

妹.story: A woman who has not yet grown up: younger sister.

私.story: Grain kept for yourself: I, private.

者.story: An old man sitting in the sun: a person (who does).

主.story: A dot of flame on a lamp stand, the centre of the house: master.

親.story: Standing on a tree to watch over you: a parent.

族.story: People under one flag with arrows: a tribe, a family.

民.story: People with their eyes closed: the people, the nation.

口.story: An open mouth drawn square. If a kanji involves speaking, eating, naming or a hole, look for it.

目.story: An eye stood on end, with the pupil drawn as two bars.

耳.story: An ear, with the lobe drawn at the side.

手.story: Four fingers and a wrist, drawn as three horizontals down one vertical. On the left it becomes 扌.
traps: noon: two lines and no hook

足.story: A kneecap over a foot: leg, foot, and to be enough.

体.story: A person's origin, the thing they were issued at birth, is the body.

顔.story: The front of the head: face.

首.story: Hair on top of the head: neck, head.

心.story: A heart with three drops flying off it. In Japanese it covers the mind as well as the emotions.
traps: certain (N3): a stroke through the heart
fire: four dots at the bottom, not a heart

医.story: An arrow in a box, the tool kit of a doctor: medicine.

病.story: A body lying on a sickbed: illness.

力.story: A flexed arm, or a plough driven into the ground. Two strokes, enormous mileage.
traps: sword: the hook moves to the top right
ten thousand: one line across the top

川.story: Three strands of water flowing: a river.

天.story: Something above even the biggest person: heaven, sky.
traps: husband (N3): the line pierces the head

雨.story: Rain falling from a cloud onto the window.

花.story: Grass that changes into something beautiful: a flower.

空.story: A hole dug so wide you see the sky: sky, empty.

水.story: A current with spray flying off both banks. On the left it collapses to three splashes 氵.

木.story: A trunk, two branches, two roots. One of the cleanest pictographs in the set.
traps: origin: a mark across the roots

土.story: A plant pushing up out of the soil.
traps: samurai: the top line is longer

海.story: Water in every direction: the sea.

池.story: Water that stays put: a pond.

地.story: Earth, and also more earth: the ground.

森.story: Three trees crowded together: a forest.

林.story: Two trees standing side by side. You can still walk between them.

野.story: The land beyond the village: a field, wild.

光.story: A torch carried on legs, sparks flying: light.

風.story: An insect carried in a sail: wind.

春.story: Three people out enjoying the sun: spring.

夏.story: Dragging your legs in the heat: summer.

冬.story: Legs slipping on two patches of ice: winter.

暑.story: The sun beating down on a person: hot.

寒.story: A roof with ice gathering underneath: cold.

犬.story: A big animal with a floppy ear: dog.

鳥.story: A bird with its tail feathers down.

上.story: A mark standing above the ground line: up, above.

下.story: A mark hanging under the ceiling line: down, below.

左.story: The hand that holds the tool while the right one works: left.
traps: right: the same hand with a mouth

右.story: The hand you bring to your mouth to eat with: right.
traps: left: the same hand holding a tool 工

中.story: A stick driven through the middle of a box: middle, inside.

外.story: Fortune-telling is done outside, at night.

前.story: A knife held in front of you: before, in front.

後.story: Dragging your feet on a short thread: behind, after.

東.story: The sun rising behind a tree: east.

西.story: A basket over a wall, where the sun sets: west.

南.story: A cross over a hanging bell, ringing in the warm south.

北.story: Two people turning their backs on the cold: north.

方.story: A flag pointing the way: direction, way, person (polite).

国.story: The king's jewel safe inside the borders: a country.

店.story: A lean-to where someone tells your fortune: a shop.

社.story: An altar set on the earth: a shrine, and the company that gathers there.

院.story: A complete building up on the hill: an institution, like a hospital.

屋.story: The place where you arrive under a roof: a shop, a roof.

家.story: A pig under the roof: a house, the old farming kind.

館.story: Where officials are fed: a hall, a building.

京.story: A tall gate with a small mouth: the capital.

区.story: A box with a cross inside: a ward, a district.

県.story: A head hung up on display: a prefecture.

建.story: A brush stretched out on the plan: to build.

市.story: Cloth hung up under a roof: a market, a city.

室.story: The place under the roof you finally arrive at: a room.

住.story: A person who is master of the house: to live.

所.story: A door and an axe: a place.

場.story: A patch of earth in the sunshine: a place.

村.story: Land measured out around a tree, the shade where people settled.

町.story: Fields with a street running through them: town.

都.story: Where all the people live: a capital.

堂.story: A grand building with a mouth for a door, standing on earth: a hall.

門.story: A pair of saloon doors facing each other. Whatever you put between them is the story.

台.story: Your own mouth up on a stand, like a speaker on a platform.
traps: begin contains the whole of 台

車.story: A cart seen from above: axle and two wheels.
traps: east: a tree behind the sun

電.story: Lightning out of the rain clouds: electricity.

道.story: Your head pointed down a path. The way you are heading is your way.

駅.story: Where horses were changed after a measured distance: station.

運.story: An army on the road, hauling its supplies: to carry, and the luck that goes with it.

旅.story: People following a flag: to travel.
traps: tribe: an arrow instead of people

乗.story: A person climbing a tree: to ride.

通.story: Movement through a funnel: in one end, out the other.

転.story: A wheel spinning up dust: to roll over, revolve.

発.story: Feet springing off like an arrow: to depart.

着.story: A sheep's wool pulled over your eyes: to wear, and to arrive.

学.story: A child under a roof with knowledge glittering above: to study.

校.story: Wooden benches where people cross paths and mingle. That is a school.

先.story: Legs out in front, leading the way: ahead, previous.

生.story: A plant springing up from the soil: life, birth.

本.story: A mark cut across the roots, pointing at where the tree comes from. Hence origin, hence the thing that holds knowledge.
traps: body contains the whole of 本

語.story: The words I claim as mine: my language.

読.story: Words put up for sale. Somebody has to buy them and read them.

書.story: A brush held over a sheet: to write.

英.story: The finest flower in the centre: excellent, and England.

漢.story: The Han river, which gave its name to China and to kanji.

字.story: A child under the roof practising letters: a character.

文.story: A pattern on someone's chest: writing.

紙.story: Fibres pressed flat so a family can write its name on them.

教.story: An old man and a child with a stick: to teach.

習.story: A baby bird flapping white wings again and again: to learn.

勉.story: Effort spent escaping ignorance. Which is what you are doing right now.

試.story: Words spoken under formal ceremony: a test, a trial.

験.story: Every horse put through its paces: a test.

究.story: Digging nine holes deep to get to the bottom of it: research.

題.story: The correct thing at the head of a page: a title, a topic.

問.story: A mouth at the gate. You cannot come in until you have answered.

答.story: A bamboo slip that fits the question: an answer.

質.story: Two axes weighed against money: quality.

図.story: A frame drawn around a sketch: a map, a plan.

仕.story: A person waiting on a samurai: to serve. 仕事 is the work that serving becomes.

業.story: A bell stand, the work of a craftsman: business, work.

員.story: A mouth to feed and a salary to pay: a member of staff.

働.story: A person plus motion. Japan invented this one: moving people are working people.

理.story: The grain in a jewel: logic, reason.

食.story: Something good under a lid: food, to eat.

飲.story: Food, and a wide open mouth: to drink.

魚.story: A head, a scaly body and a tail: fish.

牛.story: A cow's head with a horn.

菜.story: Greens you pick by hand: vegetables.

茶.story: Leaves from a small tree, dried under a roof: tea.

飯.story: Food you turn over in the pot: cooked rice, a meal.

味.story: Something your mouth has not yet finished deciding about: its taste.
traps: younger sister: 未 beside a woman

料.story: Rice being measured: a fee, a material.

洋.story: Water rolling like a flock of sheep: the ocean, and what comes from across it, Western.

映.story: The sun right in the centre, thrown back as a reflection: to reflect, to screen a film.

画.story: A field drawn inside a frame: a picture.

音.story: A standing figure singing to the sun: sound.

楽.story: Threads strung across a wooden frame: an instrument, music, fun.
traps: medicine: the same with grass on top

歌.story: A mouth wide open, again and again: a song.

写.story: Putting a cover over something to copy it: to copy, to photograph.

見.story: An eye on legs: to see.

言.story: A mouth at the bottom with sound waves stacked above it and a lid on top.
traps: sound: 日 at the base instead of 口

話.story: Words plus tongue. Speaking is words that have actually left the body.

聞.story: An ear pressed to the gate, listening for what is on the other side.

知.story: Words shot like an arrow from the mouth: to know.

思.story: A heart with a field laid over it, the mind divided into neat plots: to think.

考.story: An old man bent over, thinking: to consider.

説.story: Words exchanged until the other person understands: to explain.

声.story: A samurai shouting from the gate: voice.

行.story: Left foot, right foot: to go.

来.story: A tree bent with fruit that is about to come: to come.
traps: rice (N3): the same cross, no base line

出.story: Two mountains stacked, sprouting up: to go out.

入.story: An arrowhead pointing in: to enter.
traps: person: the long stroke is on the other side

帰.story: Picking up the broom back home: to return.

急.story: A hand grabbing at your heart: hurry!

走.story: A foot kicking up earth: to run.

歩.story: A few steps, stopping each time: to walk.

進.story: A bird can only fly forward, never backward: to advance.

動.story: Force applied to something heavy. Motion is what happens next.

近.story: An axe lying just down the road, within easy reach: near.

遠.story: A long robe trailing behind you on a long road: far.

送.story: A parcel sent off down the road: to send.

休.story: A person props themselves against a tree trunk and stops walking.
traps: body: one extra line turns 木 into 本

立.story: A person standing firmly on the ground.

引.story: Pulling back a bowstring: to pull.

開.story: Two hands lifting the bar out of the doorway: to open.
traps: close (N3): a bar jammed across instead

起.story: You yourself get up and run: to rise.

作.story: A person working a saw back and forth: to make.
traps: yesterday (N3): the same saw beside a sun

使.story: A person sent out by an official on an errand: to use someone, then anything.
traps: convenience: 吏 and 更 differ only at the top

持.story: Carrying something to the temple in your hands, all the way there: to hold.
traps: wait: step 彳 instead of hand
special: cow 牛 instead of hand

集.story: Birds flocking onto one tree: to gather.

切.story: A sword cutting seven times: to cut.

洗.story: Water first, before anything else happens. Wash your hands before you eat.

待.story: Steps at the temple, where you wait your turn.

大.story: A person who has stopped walking and thrown both arms wide: big.

小.ex: 小学校{しょうがっこう}
小.story: A small stroke with two crumbs falling off: small.

高.story: A tower with windows on every floor: high, and so expensive.

安.story: A woman safe under a roof: peaceful, and cheap enough to relax.

長.story: An old man with long hair flowing: long, chief.

新.story: Standing a tree up and cutting it with an axe: fresh wood, new.
traps: parent: 見 instead of 斤

古.story: A story passed through ten mouths: old.

少.story: Small, with a slice cut off: few, a little.

白.story: The sun with a drop of light breaking over it: white.

悪.story: A second-rate heart. Not broken, just not good.

暗.story: No sun, only sound. When you can hear but not see, it is dark.

明.story: Sun and moon in the sky at once: the brightest thing you can draw.

強.story: An insect strong enough to draw a bow: strong.

弱.story: Two bows with tattered strings: weak.

軽.story: A cart light enough to lift: light.

重.story: A thousand villages piled up: heavy.

広.story: A lean-to with space for your own things: wide.

好.story: A woman with her child: to like, to love.

太.story: A big person with a little extra at the bottom: fat, thick.
traps: dog: the dot is up by the ear

短.story: An arrow no longer than a bean: short.

低.story: A person bowing so low their family name touches the floor.

青.story: Fresh growth under the moon: blue, green, young.

赤.story: Earth glowing over a fire: red.

黒.story: A village covered in soot from the fire: black.

色.story: A person kneeling in coloured cloth: colour.

何.story: A person who can do anything keeps asking: what?

不.story: A sprout pushing up and blocked by the ground: not.

以.story: A plough blade and a person: by means of.

意.story: The sound your heart makes before you say it out loud: intention, meaning.

回.story: A box spinning inside a box: to turn, and a number of times.

界.story: The line between fields: a boundary, the world.

元.story: Two lines standing on legs: the origin that everything stands on.

合.story: A lid that fits exactly over the mouth of a jar: to fit, to join.

産.story: Standing at the cliff edge, life comes out: to produce, to give birth.

自.story: The nose you point at when you mean yourself: self.

事.story: A hand holding a tool at work: a matter, a thing.

真.story: Ten eyes looking straight at it: true.

正.story: Stopping exactly at the line: correct.

世.story: Thirty years: a generation, the world.

注.story: Water aimed at the main spot. Pour it there, and put your attention there too.

度.story: Measuring under the lean-to, hand over hand: degree, times.

同.story: Everyone inside the same frame, speaking with one mouth: the same.

特.story: A cow at the temple: special.

別.story: A knife cutting one thing off from another: separate.

便.story: A person who renews things for you on demand: convenient. It also means post, delivered again and again.
traps: use: watch the top of the right side

有.story: A hand holding meat: to have.

用.story: A bucket in a frame: to use.
